reviews.title: Reliable, stable, organized.
reviews.text: 13 years strong here, straightforward notes app where I do all of my short-form writing--mostly poetry and songwriting. Super organized, has a search feature, date of entry stays the same even if you update your work, and if you do multiple entries in one day it shows you now many when you back out to view months/days. Sucks that ads default to block half the screen now, but flicking the app away and pulling it back up moves them out of view. If you want to backup your entries, you can find a simple Share All option in Settings and decide which method is right for you. This is the only app I ever use for more than a decade worth of writing and I hope that they maintain the same UI as they have since day 1. It is perfect as-is, coming from a professional, and I hope I never have to swap to any other app.

Worst of all is the unbelievable number of ads. An amazing variety of advertisers, so good for the developer. But they take up about a third of the page and I’d say at least 30% of the time when I click the down arrow to minimize the ad, if my finger is an iota off, it opens the ad instead. Hope these issues can be addressed in an update. UPDATE: arghh! You just moved ads to top where they take up less room but now they cannot be removed?! Please let us get rid of them entirely after we have seen them as was the case before! Or let us revert to the older version!

reviews.title: Great Journal!
reviews.text:
I love using this app to jot down personal memories as they happen, and things I don’t want to forget.  The way all entries from the same day fall on the same page, and then each page is a day, and the whole thing is essentially a chronological book all by default formatting is amazing for keeping track of life’s story!  When I go back and read my memories, it’s like reading an e-book about my family’s life.  So cool.

Everything from the Table of Contents to each entry is intuitive—the thing just works.

The flipping of pages as you go from day to day—charming!

There are no unnecessary features that overwhelm me like in other apps; just write the stuff you want to remember.  Simple.  No need to save in dated folders—that’s already handled.  No need to format some special document—that’s already handled.

Easy.  Charming.  10/10

Love it!!!!

reviews.title: Fine, but turns into a worse version of itself if you use it for free for long enough
reviews.text:
Tl;dr: I think this app is rigged to make the ads more annoying after you use it for half a year.
I downloaded this app because it was the only one I could find that arranges your entries oldest to newest instead of vice versa like a social media feed. And its minimalistic approach is its greatest strength and weakness. (Sometimes I want to attach photos to an entry.) But one day, the app just switched up on me. Every time I opened it, the ad banner at the top of the screen would load for three seconds and then expand to take up 50% of the screen, so I can’t see what I’m typing until I click the little ‘shrink ad’ button in the corner. This change may have simply been added in an update… But it feels more like the app was programmed to wait until I was a long-time, stalwart user, before hitting me with bigger and better-paying ads, believing I’d be so hooked I would either put up with them, or shell out $5 to remove them. My greatest regret is not making a note of the exact day this happened, so now I have to guess based off of the slow decline of my journal-per-month rate: I downloaded this app in February, and my output peters off at July to September? Anyways, future users beware.
